Zoe (People Ops): Heads up — new hire Priya's I-9 failed the kiosk passport scan (glare on photo). She starts Mon 03/08, remote (PST). Need a plan so she can clear I-9 on day 1 and get laptop/access on time.
Mike-IT: Thanks Zoe. Laptop is queued to ship Fri standard. If we need overnight I can switch to 2-day or overnight. Which do you prefer?
Zoe (People Ops): If we can avoid overnight cost, try 2-day. But if the I-9 can't be completed remotely we'll need her to sign/access earlier. I'll try to arrange an authorized agent.
Arjun (Hiring Manager): I can meet Priya in SF on Monday AM to do the in-person verification if that's acceptable. I'm not an authorized I-9 agent though — does the company need a notary or authorized verifier?
Tara (People Ops): Quick clarifying note: Section 2 has to be completed by an authorized representative or employer agent. We have a vendor notary list and we also allow an approved company rep (we keep a notarization waiver in special cases). Zoe — I can schedule a partner notary near her zip if she prefers.
Zoe (People Ops): Priya is in Portland, OR (97205). Please try the notary vendor first — faster. If vendor not available, Arjun can coordinate with a manager attestation form (we have a manager-attest workflow).
Checkr-Bot: Background check status: PENDING — name mismatch detected. Action required: candidate to confirm full legal name and upload government ID. Link: https://hr.redwood.com/checkr/verify/ABCD1234
Zoe (People Ops): @Priya (cc'd via email) please confirm your full legal name exactly as on documents and re-upload a clearer passport or driver's license photo to that Checkr link. Also I can send Notary scheduler link if you want an in-person appointment.
Emma (Onboarding Buddy): I'll run the day1 orientation (intro, benefits quickstart, app access). Please let me know laptop arrival window so I can sync the walkthrough.
Mike-IT: Got it — I'll hold the laptop for pickup at our SF office if overnight requested, otherwise ship to her home. If you want pickup, use tracking code `1Z999AA10123456784` once I switch to overnight.
Tara (People Ops): Zoe — I'll send Priya the notary options and the manager-attest form as fallback. Also sending the Form I-9 checklist and a short KBA (knowledge-based identity) step we sometimes use when photo quality is borderline.
Zoe (People Ops): Perfect. Action items: 1) Priya to re-upload clearer ID to Checkr (Zoe sent link) 2) Tara to schedule notary near 97205 or provide manager-attest fallback 3) Mike to keep laptop on hold / switch to 2-day shipping 4) Emma to prep Day 1 runbook.
Arjun (Hiring Manager): I'll block Mon 9–10am in case we need the manager-attest in-person.
Mike-IT: I'll update shipping method based on final call; tagging cost center PO-ONBOARD.
Zoe (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll follow up with candidate and update thread. Priya, expect an email from Tara with scheduling options and from Checkr for the re-upload. :wave:
(people-ops note): closed loop — follow up scheduled for 03/06 to confirm I-9 status and laptop ETA.
